rationale: Started 2026-11-10T08:19:02Z; ended 2026-11-10T08:34:20Z (UTC). I did not produce this decision. Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (21 FR 7199): EO 10679 of Sept. 20, 1956 prescribes the terms of State or Territorial retirement withholding agreements for National Guard civilian technicians under the Act of June 15, 1956, designates withholding officers, limits consent, defines employees and delegates rule-making; identity is confirmed. Its 120-day agreement deadline is a duty, not an end of the order. The held FR text of EO 10996 (27 FR 1521, Feb. 16, 1962) restates every command in Secs. 1-6, continues earlier agreements and actions in Sec. 7 under the new order, and says in Sec. 8 that it supersedes Executive Order No. 10679 of September 20, 1956, with no deferred effective date; the current 5 U.S.C. 5518 note (current-law MENTIONS) prints EO 10996 with that Sec. 8. Cruden found no other ending text, so the whole order ended 1962-02-16, nothing of it survives as its own command, and status no holds.
